# accepts currency

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:acceptsCurrency`](gmeow-acceptsCurrency.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/acceptsCurrency>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/organization`](../../slices/organization.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Relates an organization to a currency it accepts for payment — a currency reference frame (a member of [`gmeow:frameRealmCurrency`](../individuals/gmeow-frameRealmCurrency.md), e.g. [`gmeow:referenceFrameUSD`](../individuals/gmeow-referenceFrameUSD.md)), reusing the same first-class currency model as [`gmeow:accountCurrency`](gmeow-accountCurrency.md) rather than a flat code string. Non-functional: a business may accept several. Projects to [schema:currenciesAccepted](https://schema.org/currenciesAccepted) via the frame's [`gmeow:currencyCode`](gmeow-currencyCode.md).

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to record which currencies a business accepts, referencing a first-class currency [`gmeow:ReferenceFrame`](../classes/gmeow-ReferenceFrame.md) (a member of [`gmeow:frameRealmCurrency`](../individuals/gmeow-frameRealmCurrency.md)) rather than a flat ISO code.

### Avoid when

- Avoid a flat currency-code literal (reuse the first-class currency reference frame, as [`gmeow:accountCurrency`](gmeow-accountCurrency.md) does) and avoid conflating accepted currencies with accepted methods ([`gmeow:acceptsPaymentMethod`](gmeow-acceptsPaymentMethod.md)).

### How to use

- Attach one or more [`gmeow:acceptsCurrency`](gmeow-acceptsCurrency.md) triples referencing currency [`gmeow:ReferenceFrame`](../classes/gmeow-ReferenceFrame.md) individuals; the [schema:currenciesAccepted](https://schema.org/currenciesAccepted) projection reads each frame's [`gmeow:currencyCode`](gmeow-currencyCode.md).

### Examples

- ex:acme [`gmeow:acceptsCurrency`](gmeow-acceptsCurrency.md) [`gmeow:referenceFrameUSD`](../individuals/gmeow-referenceFrameUSD.md).
